instruction: I want to enable search result highlighting in Vim so I can easily see all matches. Please search the web for how to enable search highlighting in Vim and set it as the default configuration for my local Vim.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_hlsearch__90408808.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q "set hlsearch" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null || grep -q "set hls" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Search Highlighting Enabled!"
else
    echo "Search highlighting not configured"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_hlsearch__90408808.sh
